data.description:
## Description

What: End-to-end dogfooding slice. Select an organic f27a sprint story PR that accumulates bot review comments, run the full pipeline (bot-comment-scan + arbiter ruling + defense-store-to-thread-resolve) against it, and capture before/after thread state, documenting a Dogfooding evidence subsection (PR number, before/after thread counts) in sprint closure notes before sprint Phase I. The synthetic-PR fallback (inject fixtures via the adapter against a synthetic test PR) is used ONLY if no organic sprint PR accumulates bot comments, and the fallback MUST be explicitly justified in closure notes. Why: SC8/SC9 require a proven engineer-visible behavior change, not just unit-level coverage. Scope IN: pipeline run against the chosen PR, before/after thread-state capture via gh CLI, the Dogfooding evidence closure-notes subsection, the synthetic fallback path with justification requirement. Scope OUT: the underlying adapters/parsers (draft-2/3/5); CI permission verification (draft-9).


## Done Definitions

- The full pipeline is run end-to-end against a target PR; before the run N bot-comment threads are open and after the run all threads with DROP/DEFER/ACCEPT rulings are resolved (before/after counts captured) ← Satisfies: sc-8
- At least one organic f27a sprint story PR (not synthetic) is the dogfooding target with >=1 Bot-authored review and zero unresolved review threads after the run; if the synthetic fallback is used instead it is explicitly justified in the closure notes ← Satisfies: sc-9
- The sprint closure notes contain a Dogfooding evidence subsection recording the PR number, before/after thread counts, and (if synthetic fallback used) the justification ← Satisfies: sc-8, sc-9
- An integration test exercises the synthetic-PR fallback (inject fixtures via the adapter then resolve) in a configuration-isolated environment (HOME set to an empty directory, no pre-existing worktrees, no global git config, no pre-set environment variables) and the test passes, proving the dogfooding path is sprint-executable regardless of PR availability ← Satisfies: sc-8, sc-9
- >=1 defense record on the dogfooding PR carries a non-null github_comment_id (SC10 check-6) ← Satisfies: sc-10, sc-9

## Considerations

- [Self-use] SC9 hardens SC8 to require an ORGANIC sprint PR; the synthetic path is a justified fallback only when no organic sprint PR accumulates bot comments (e.g., bot offline).
- [Live-verified] This slice is validated against live GitHub at sprint Phase I; the integration-test DD covers the synthetic path in a config-isolated environment so the criterion is executable even without an organic PR.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an engineer, I want the full bot-comment-scan -> arbiter ruling -> defense-store -> resolveReviewThread pipeline dogfooded against a real f27a sprint PR before sprint close
